prev.description: the community anchor the rotation leaves (Identity 5.4)

next.description: the community anchor the rotation moves to: the next generation of the same digest (Identity 5.4); it differs from prev, and the binding computed over next equals the binding held for prev (the commit of the card or rotation that introduced prev)

commit.description: the pre-rotation binding to the generation after next: u + base64url (unpadded) of the sha2-256 multihash (0x12 0x20 || 32 digest bytes) over the multikey bytes of that generation's Ed25519 public key, 0xed 0x01 || 32 key bytes (Identity 5.4, 8.1)

proofValue.description: raw Ed25519 under prev over the canonical (JCS) bytes of body, z-base58btc

successorProofValue.description: raw Ed25519 under next over the same bytes

title: RLTP anchor-rotation@2 (rltp-trust@0.31)
description: The holder's statement that its community anchor moved from one key to the next (Trust Layer 6.5, Identity 5.4): signed by both keys, carrying the pre-rotation binding to the generation after next. The chain order is given by prev and next alone. It is valid toward a contact only where the binding held for prev equals the binding computed over next. It travels inside anchor-mapping@4 (lineage) and inside the holder's own log (Access 5.6); it is never exported beyond those two (RLTP-TRU-6350, RLTP-ACC-5975).
